note: Runtime UI rows whose translation is wrong in sense. The guides use a correct term; these rows need a runtime-catalog fix.

defects.Anndata nan policy: 'एनडीए नैन नीति' reads 'NDA nan policy'; the field is 'Anndata NaN नीति'
defects.Anndata single table: 'एंड्रॉयड एकल टेबल' means 'Android single table'; the field is 'Anndata एकल तालिका'
defects.Cell probability: 'संभावनाओं सेल' is ungrammatical ('probabilities cell', सेल as in a battery); the view is 'कोशिका संभावना'
defects.Clear all: 'सब स्पष्ट' means 'all (is) clear/obvious'; the button is 'सब साफ़ करें'
defects.Model zoo…: 'जानवरों का मॉडल...' means 'model of animals'; the screen is 'मॉडल संग्रह…'
defects.Open folder…: 'खुले फ़ोल्डर...' means 'open (unlocked) folders'; the action is 'फ़ोल्डर खोलें…'
defects.Parameter sweep: 'पैरामीटर स्विप' is a misspelt transliteration; the module is named 'पैरामीटर स्वीप'
defects.Promote calls to annotation: 'नोटिस के लिए कॉल करने के लिए प्रोत्साहित करें' means 'encourage calling for a notice'
defects.Re-flood below the escape: 'भागने के नीचे फिर से बारिश' means 'rain again below the fleeing'
defects.Resume checkpoint: 'चेक पॉइंट' drops 'resume'; the switch is 'चेकपॉइंट से फिर शुरू करें'
defects.Save mask: 'मास्क बचाएं' means 'rescue the mask'; the button is 'मास्क सहेजें'
defects.Taper onto the gradient: 'ग्रेडिएंट के लिए टैप' means 'tap for the gradient'
defects.Train: 'ट्रेन' reads as a railway train; the Workbench tab is 'प्रशिक्षण'
defects.Setting animations: 'एनीमेशन सेट करें' means 'set (an) animation' (imperative); the Preferences item is 'सेटिंग एनिमेशन'
defects.Activation Maps: 'कार्रवाई के नक्शे' means 'maps of (police) action'; the screen is 'सक्रियण मानचित्र'
defects.Nucleus flow threshold: 'परमाणु प्रवाह सीमा' uses परमाणु (atom/atomic); the cell nucleus is केंद्रक: 'केंद्रक प्रवाह सीमा'
defects.Nucleus diameter: 'परमाणु डायमेटर' means 'atomic diameter'; the setting is 'केंद्रक व्यास'
defects.Z projection: 'Z प्रोजेक्ट' means 'Z project' (a work project); the setting is 'Z प्रक्षेपण'
